No registration is required. Once an eligible user completes their first stock transfer during the promotion, the system automatically calculates the reward based on the amount actually received. Each user can only earn a reward for their first stock transfer.

Before each reward installment is distributed, the system verifies the current value of your rToken holdings.

Eligibility is verified separately for each reward round.

The time required depends on the delivering broker's processing efficiency, the settlement status of the stocks, and whether the transfer information is complete.
Users can check the current stock transfer status under "Track progress". If the transfer fails, they can resubmit it based on the reason shown on the page or contact Bitget customer service for assistance.

Users can select "Track progress" on the promotion page to view the current stock transfer status, including transfer initiated, awaiting transfer-out by the delivering broker, stocks credited, and subsequent processing.
Reward details can be viewed in the "Reward Center," including the actual stock transfer amount, applicable reward tier, reward amount, and distribution status of each round.

## Flash Earn now offers three ways to earn:

Reward asset | USDC

Trading volume includes USDC spot and margin trading, as well as spot, margin, perpetual, futures trading on USDs order books where USDC is settlement currency. Spot trades in both directions (USDT → USDC and USDC → USDT) count towards the campaign’s cumulative trading volume requirement. Trades made through Convert are excluded.
Eligible USDC pairs exclude the following: Zcash (ZEC), Dash (DASH), TRON (TRX), Mina (MINA), Mask (MASK), Polyhedra (ZKJ), Vana (VANA).
## How to join
Open the campaign page through Flash Earn > Hold to Earn and click Join Now on the selected campaign. Enrollment must be successful before you can be considered for rewards; holding USDC alone does not enroll you automatically. Rewards start from 00:00:00 UTC on the next UTC day after successful enrollment. No rewards accrue for the UTC day on which you enroll. Reward calculation is limited to the active campaign period.
Complete at least USD 1,000 in trading volume across eligible USDC pairs and hold minimally 10,000 USDC in your main account's eligible accounts during the campaign period.
Rewards for each UTC campaign day become available to claim from 08:00 UTC on the following day, after daily settlement. Visit the campaign page to claim your available rewards.
## Eligibility
You must complete identity verification to participate in this campaign. Participation is limited to eligible main accounts holding VIP status that meet the campaign's jurisdiction and OKX entity requirements.
Sub-accounts, KYB users and institutional users are not eligible to participate.
## Important notes
VIP status: Users can qualify for VIP status through either trading volume or asset holdings. You can check the applicable trading volume requirements on this page. If you do not meet this requirement, you will see an ineligibility message when you select Join Now on the campaign page.
Daily calculation window: Each UTC campaign day runs from 00:00:00 to 23:59:59 (UTC). Random snapshots of your eligible account are taken at random times throughout the campaign day. At each snapshot, your qualifying holding is calculated as your trading account USDC equity, less any outstanding Flexible Loan USDC liabilities held across your main account and sub-accounts. Your daily qualifying holding value is the lowest of these snapshot values for that day. It is not your average or end-of-day balance. Rewards start from 00:00:00 UTC on the next UTC day after successful enrollment. No rewards accrue for the UTC day on which you enroll. For example, if you join at 12:00 UTC on Day 1, you earn no rewards for Day 1. Your first eligible calculation window is Day 2, 00:00:00–23:59:59 UTC, provided it falls within the active campaign period. Rewards for Day 2 become claimable from 08:00 UTC on Day 3, after daily settlement.
Minimum holding requirement: If your daily qualifying holding value is below 10,000 USDC, you will not receive a reward for that day. Borrowed USDC does not count. Your qualifying holding is calculated net of Flexible Loan USDC liabilities. Liabilities held in your sub-accounts are included in this calculation, even though sub-accounts cannot participate in the campaign. USDC obtained through borrowing will not increase your qualifying holding value or your share of the daily pool.
Maximum qualifying holding: Holdings above 100,000 USDC do not increase your share of the daily pool. Amounts above this threshold are excluded from the reward calculation.
Trading volume requirement: You must complete at least USD 1,000 in cumulative trading volume on eligible USDC pairs during the campaign period. This is a one-off qualification; once met, it applies for the remainder of the campaign. If the trading requirement is not met, no rewards will be distributed even if you've met the other qualifying requirements. Volume on restricted pairs does not count. Applicable to spot, margin, perp & futures trading volume as well as options where the settlement currency is in USDC. Spot trades in both directions (USDT → USDC and USDC → USDT) count towards the campaign’s cumulative trading volume requirement. Trades made through Convert are excluded.
Reward calculation: Your daily reward is your proportional share of the daily reward pool, capped at an annualised rate of 8%, calculated as follows:
Daily reward before rounding = MIN((Your daily qualifying USDC holdings ÷ Total daily qualifying USDC holdings of all eligible participants) × Daily reward pool,Your daily qualifying USDC holdings × 8% ÷ 365)
Qualifying holdings are subject to the minimum holding requirement and a per-user holding cap of USD 100,000 worth of USDC. The total campaign reward budget is divided across 30 eligible settlement days. Rewards are rounded down to the supported reward-asset precision.
## Estimated APR: The estimated APR is calculated as follows:
Estimated APR = MIN((Daily reward pool ÷ Total daily qualifying USDC holdings of all eligible participants) × 365, 8%)
The estimated APR may vary with total qualifying holdings and is capped at 8%. Displayed asset values and estimated APR are for reference only. This campaign does not offer a fixed APR or guaranteed return. Final rewards depend on daily settlement and the campaign rules.
Changes in holdings: Buying more USDC later in the same UTC day does not increase a lower value already captured in an applicable snapshot. Selling, transferring, withdrawing or otherwise reducing your USDC holdings may reduce or eliminate that day's reward. The minimum is determined separately for each UTC day.
Reference figures: Displayed asset values and estimated APR are for reference only. This campaign does not offer a fixed APR or guaranteed return. Final rewards depend on daily settlement and the campaign rules.
Daily claiming: Rewards for each UTC campaign day become available to claim from 08:00 UTC on the following day, after daily settlement. You may claim rewards that are available on the campaign page; settlement does not itself transfer those rewards into your account.
